qualitative_updates.note: Sell Fries! [Anomaly] (23 days) leads Up-and-Coming and was the biggest Most Popular riser (+30); Home Alone: Anomalies stays on Top Trending. Halloween season remains a confounder, and Sell Fries! is also among the least efficient Top Earning games.

Day 2 of support: Steal A Verity! (-24) and Kick a Lucky Block (-31) are among the biggest Most Popular fallers, 'Steal' titles go with weaker Top Trending momentum (r -0.55), and steal loops have the lowest Up-and-Coming median (19), while Steal An Egg still leads. Counter: Steal An EXE Egg rose 32 on Top Trending.

Scooter Empire (+144) and THROTTLE Motorcycle Street Racing (+126) were among the biggest Top Earning risers, and racing_driving loops now have the best median Top Earning percentile (72) of profiled loops; WRONG WAY! stays among the Top Trending leaders. Scooter Empire fell 25 on Up-and-Coming.
Day 9: 123-365-day games again have a low median pillar percentile (35), below 15-42-day games (45) and multi-year games (62); 85-122 days has only 2 games.

actions.action: Don't rely on survival games for revenue
